<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈210.069 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 33 % of M) is characteristic of a single chlorine atom. A formula that fits this mass and includes one Cl atom is C₉H₁₉ClO₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H19ClO3</final_answer>
